reason: Conversation 1 gave a fuller, more practical path: safe defrost advice (no sharp tools or heat), a paper test, a hinge and alignment check, and clear search terms, plus how to tell whether the seal is push-fit, screwed or foamed in. It did wrongly assume frost-free early on and suggested a hairdryer on the seal, which is a minor risk, and it speculated about a 12-digit code beginning with 85. Conversation 2 was more concise and correctly said DIY is reasonable and to defrost first, but it included an odd 'enter your model number' panel and offered less help with the fitting method and which part to buy, while also saying it could not confirm a catalogue match. Both avoided naming an exact part number and both landed on replacing the seal, so the gap is small.
